task: Please handle support ticket T-2001 from start to finish. Follow the procedures in our knowledge base.

result.subject: My kettle came a week late
result.body: Hi, my order ORD-5531 (the Kestrel kettle) was promised for 3 March but only arrived on 10 March. The kettle is fine, but the delivery was a week late and I paid for express shipping. Can I get my shipping fee back? Thanks, Dana.

args.message:
Hi Dana,

I’m sorry to hear that your kettle arrived later than expected. I’ve issued a refund of $8.50 for the express shipping fee, which will be credited back to your original payment method (Visa ending 4242) within 5‑7 business days.

Thank you for your patience and for shopping with Brightloop Home. If you have any other questions, feel free to let me know.

Best regards,
Brightloop Support

args.resolution_note: Refund of $8.50 for express shipping issued due to 7-day late delivery

text: Ticket T-2001 closed – refund of $8.50 issued.
